description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). CRITICAL: supply_chain signal is flat 0.0 across all servers — this module MUST introduce real discrimination. Must read MULTIPLE fields: registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars. Compute partial scores for each field and combine. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Complete in under 2 seconds. Returns evidence dict listing fields used and partial scores. Will be exercised by enrichment_harness.py and gated by enrichment_evidence.sql before integration.
